payload.rationale: The obligation asks whether (1) the Report entries for Cyanide, Total Recoverable at Outfall 001 establish that no enforceable numeric discharge limit applies for compliance comparison, and (2) the 1/Quarter (*1) monitoring requirement applies only during discharging periods per footnote *1. For (1), the cyanide row shows Report in all four effluent limit columns (monthly/daily under both lbs/day and mg/l), while co-listed parameters in the same table carry explicit numeric limits (e.g., TSS 20/30 mg/l, Total Residual Chlorine 11 µg/L). Report is an affirmative permit-table designation here, not an absence of entries, and within Section A.1 Final Effluent Limits for Outfall 001 it establishes report-only status with no numeric effluent limitation for compliance comparison. For (2), the cyanide monitoring frequency is 1/Quarter (*1), and footnote *1 explicitly states 'When discharging,' directly conditioning (*1)-marked monitoring to discharge periods. The contextual values are also grounded: Outfall 001 is labeled Intermittent Flow in Section A.1, and footnote *1 text is present on the adjacent pages. Both conjuncts of the demanded judgment are established by the packet; no contradictory limit or monitoring applicability appears in the evidence.
